# Recreation Prompt
Build a single-file mobile portrait browser game called PrismPals Trail: Rookie League. Preserve a collection loop where the player presses and holds a central object for 1.5 seconds to complete a scan, cancels if released early, receives one weighted-rarity companion, increments total encounters and codex counts, sees a reveal overlay, and can browse/filter a persistent codex with dossier details. Present the loop as a bright Pokemon-inspired creature-collector RPG: rookie trainer, elemental pals, Pal Codex, route exploration, rival energy, evolution/growth labels, cheerful coming-of-age tone, touch-friendly portrait controls, large CTAs, readable HUD, procedural hills/grass/clouds/path, a trail charm focal object, and compact catalog-approved media feedback.

<!-- Filled by creative_remix_v5. Keep headings stable. -->
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first collection idle/clicker with rarity-weighted random creature discovery and a persistent codex.
- objective: hold the central core long enough to roll a weighted creature, reveal it, and fill a 300-entry collection archive.
- input model: tap/click CTA buttons, then press-and-hold the central object for 1.5 seconds; tap overlay to dismiss; tap inventory slots and filters.
- core loop: start -> hold central object -> scan bar fills -> weighted roll increments encounter count and item count -> reveal overlay -> codex/dossier browsing -> repeat.
- fail/friction state: no lethal fail state; friction comes from releasing early, duplicate rolls, rarity odds, reset confirmation, and collection completion pressure.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve 1.5 second hold-to-complete interaction and early-release cancel behavior.
- Preserve weighted rarity chances: Common 10, Uncommon 6, Rare 3, Legendary 1, Mythical 0.2.
- Preserve persistent localStorage collection with total encounters and per-entry counts.
- Preserve reveal overlay, tap-to-dismiss, inventory grid, rarity filters, dossier detail, and reset confirmation.
- Preserve mobile-safe scoped pointer handling on the active play object, not global touch suppression.

## Remixed target
PrismPals Trail: Rookie League reframes the protected collection loop as a bright portrait creature-collector RPG route. The player is a rookie trainer holding a trail charm to scout elemental companions, add them to a Pal Codex, watch growth/evolution labels by rarity, and feel rival pressure through HUD copy and scene props. Mechanics remain the source collection loop; the world, focal actor, scene, HUD language, feedback, and mobile art direction are regenerated as a colorful coming-of-age monster expedition.
